title: Pahlavi Texts, Part V: Marvels of Zoroastrianism
attributionNote: The Denkard is an anonymous ninth-century Pahlavi compilation. Book VII retells the life of Zarathushtra and the history of the faith; Book V treats the same themes in a shorter form.
description: Book VII of the Denkard is the Zoroastrian story of salvation: the creation of Zarathushtra, the marvels of his conception and birth, his reception of the religion from Ohrmazd, the trials of the faith under its mythical kings, and the final renovation of the world. The volume adds Book V of the Denkard and the Selections of Zad-sparam on the same subject.
historicalContext: These are the fullest surviving Pahlavi accounts of Zarathushtra's life, written centuries after the Avesta and shaping later Zoroastrian legend. E. W. West translated them for the Sacred Books of the East, volume 47 (1897), the last of his Pahlavi volumes.
availabilityNote: Complete for this volume. The Denkard's Marvels (Book VII, chapters I–XI), Book V and the Selections of Zad-sparam are streamed from the Internet Sacred Text Archive at read time, one chapter per page. The volume's introduction and editorial observations are not part of the work.
